Folder-contract files (invariant 1, SKILL.md:18): lane-messages/README.md (4,935 B) and sim-results/README.md (1,856 B) are present; sim-requests, docs/agent and resource-scans have none. Status is derived from files (invariant 9, SKILL.md:26) and already GATED: sim-requests→sim-results by scripts/check-sim-requests.mjs (preflight.mjs:533-534), unread mail by check-lane-messages.mjs (:579-580), intake row→scan file by check-resource-scan-binding.mjs (:535-536; live: 68 rows walked, 3 citing lines, 2 files, passed). Hidden form: a Record library (forms.md:67-89) with RESOURCE_INTAKE.md as its index log and resource-scans/*.json as the records. Classification: 5 *-ratchet.json files are generated (factory); 4 dated one-off reports (CLAIM_REMOVE_DISPOSITIONS_2026-09-06.json, ECC_FULL_EVALUATION_2026-09-01.md, ORG_SELF_EVALUATION_2026-09-12.md, PONYTAIL_AUDIT_2026-09-01.md) are product. Reference integrity (SKILL.md:79): those 4 have 5, 6, 8 and 10 referrers, and a scan of every docs/agent/*.md|*.json found zero files with zero referrers, so the skill's own gate classifies 0 Dead and proposes 0 moves. Walk test failure (forms.md:89, 'the index log absorbing content'): RESOURCE_INTAKE.md is 185,991 B with 68 rows (`grep -c '^| 20'`), averaging 2,680 characters and peaking at 8,491; row :128 alone is 5,466. Token estimates below are bytes÷4, derived, not tokenizer-measured. The walk for 'evaluate a shared tool' is CLAUDE.md (24,592 B ≈ 6.1k) + tool-evaluation-by-use SKILL.md (8,293 B ≈ 2.1k) + the intake log (≈46.5k) ≈ 55k tokens, against the skill's 2k-8k band (SKILL.md:97). The live symptom is this run itself: its brief pointed at :121 and the 09-19 scan and missed the same-day row :128 for the same tool. Separately, CLAUDE.md:263 says to 'read docs/agent/LOOP.md' (193,645 B ≈ 48k), but .claude/hooks/session-start.sh:130-132 prints only PHASE..NEXT ACTION, and LOOP.md:2043 says reading the STATE block is the whole procedure.

Routing lives in three GATED registries instead: the harness skill listing (check-skill-plane-conformance.mjs, preflight.mjs:398-399; live: '119 skill(s), 15 agent(s), 12 command(s) walked … passed'), org-roster.json (check-org-roster.mjs, preflight.mjs:550-551) and hand-routing.json (raised-hands). 'Every folder becomes an agent' tested: agents here are FILES (15 .claude/agents/*.md, 15/15 pin `model:` — 8 opus, 6 sonnet, 1 haiku). The folder-shaped units are the 119 skills (`git ls-files .claude/skills | awk -F/ 'NF>3{print $3}' | sort -u | wc -l` = 119, matching VENDORED.md's stated 101+18). The skill's own text describes ONE agent walking folders (SKILL.md:8,10), so the transcript's claim is not what the skill builds. Duplicate entry files (anti-pattern, SKILL.md:106; core.md:68; system-map.md:122): AGENTS.md names CLAUDE.md 0 times (`grep -c CLAUDE AGENTS.md` = 0) and carries 0 of 5 CLAUDE.md golden-rule markers (DecisionEngine, Golden, supervised, bash 3.2, validate-sim). proposal.gapClosed: A cold agent cannot find a resource's prior disposition without loading or grepping a ~46.5k-token intake log (bytes÷4, derived). RESOURCE_INTAKE.md is the record library's index log, but it has absorbed the records: 68 rows, 2,680 characters on average, 8,491 at most. That is the anti-pattern the skill names at forms.md:89 ("the index log absorbing content (it's a catalog line, not the record)"), and it fails the walk test's 2k-8k token check (SKILL.md:97). Measured consequence: this run's own brief re-scanned a tool already scanned on the same pin the same day (RESOURCE_INTAKE.md:128) without citing that row. The skill's catalog-before-shelf rule closes it: look up the resource by name before logging a row.
